row.additional_description_1: The Board will discuss issues impacting the New York City jail system.
Notice is hereby given that a public meeting will be held on August 12, 2026 at 2:30 p.m. Members of the public may attend in person or remotely.

On the following matters: SPECIAL ORDER CALENDAR 2021-43-BZII SUBJECT - Extension of time to complete construction of commercial offices. APPEALS CALENDAR 2025-54-A SUBJECT - Appeal challenging the validity of a building permit. PUBLIC DESIGN COMMISSION 30458: Installation of a courthouse ramp. 30459: Repair of a public monument.
The hearing concerns a petition for an unenclosed sidewalk cafe. Contact Jordan Example by email or phone at 555-0199. Visit https://example.com/hearing for access instructions.
The matters are ULURP No. C 240232 PQX and N 240207 ZRX. Project details: https://zap.planning.nyc.gov/projects/2024X0132.
